rows.grounds: substitute or secondary option in ritual procedure
prescriptive injunction to reject or set aside
connective particle linking to prior injunction
state of wealth or sufficient resources; first member of locative absolute
existing condition; completes locative absolute with vibhave

items.question: Under what condition must the substitute ritual option be rejected?
premises: A substitute ritual option is available as an alternative.
An abundance of materials or resources may be present.
The substitute must be avoided when such abundance exists.
items.inference: Therefore the primary prescribed method should be followed whenever sufficient resources are available.
uncertainties: The exact scope of dravyāṇāṃ as materials versus wealth is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: And one should avoid the substitute when there is an abundance of materials.
